{{Top|leg}}
The '''magnetic suction tube''' was a device primarily used to lift [[Droid/Legends|droids]] onto [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Nomadic [[Species/Legends|species]] on remote [[Planet/Legends|planets]], such as [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], used a large-scale version of this device to help them earn a living selling lost or discarded droids.
